verdicts.reason: A turns the headline into a large three-line block, so it is clearly the hero and easy to read. But the building photo is still the original thin strip, floating at mid-left, and the start of 'the limit' runs into the photo. The bottom third of the canvas is empty and the right margin is uneven. B simply drops the original banner into the middle of the canvas with large empty bands above and below, and 'the limit for us.' now sits directly on the busy striped photo, hurting legibility. It is an unadapted letterbox, not a resize.
